book.name: Apokalips
book.title: Apokalips Gamin kuuk Buŋ bayniiji ɗo Yaaya

content: Ŋu ozilaag Buŋ ɗo wer kaak ŋa hokumiyo
Min ŋaar-ak, nu tala pey botol pil waakilak ka samaaner. Nu dortu pey gaaƴ toŋgo ar perne taat kaawdu awalle. Ta kolintu aman : « As cok anne, naan̰ gaarin̰ maan kaak yaa ase neginda. »
Koɗok di, Ruwwin ta Buŋdi miinintu. Ek di nu taltu pey ka samaaner-aka, ɗo wer-ak gin sees ka sultan. Sees-ak gay waan goyji kuwa.
ar dambay kuuk gasɗo badam. Ho ɗo wer ka seesdi-ak, *darjin ta Buŋdi irn̰a cuu balan̰
Nu taltu pey seesin ku sultan orok seer iŋ pooɗ leeyiig sees kaak waan goyji-aka. Seesin-ak gay, aginay orok seer iŋ pooɗ goyco kuwa. Aginay-ak is kesuun portiko ho iŋ kadumuulna ku daabner.
Min ɗo sees-ak, irn̰e cippit-cippit, awn̰e dindirim-dindirim ho hawin cayyi oki. Ɗo uŋji ka sees kaak ɗatko, gin akinay peesira. Akinay-ak gay, ŋuur ko ruwwinnay ku Buŋdi kuuk peesira.
Ho ɗo uŋji ka sees-ak gay goy pey wer ar barre kaak ƴaraaŋ ar gazzaza. Gin pey gamin kuuk siikimaw pooɗ leeyiig sees kaak waan goyji-aka. Uŋda aaro, ziŋkico okin̰co gin odina.
Min gamin kuuk pooɗ siikimaw-ak : ka awalle ar boori, ka seeriŋkar ar ijilin̰ce, ka subbiŋkar wijeeney ar ta gemor, ho ka pooɗiŋkar gay ar sersir
Gamin kuuk pooɗ-ak, okin̰co gin gezgir bijigiƴ bijigiƴ. Gezgirco-ak anuwco odin di, min kara yoo atta oki. Aando, ƴiriyo, ŋu riya di. Riyinco gay aman :

content.text: Kiŋ *Rabbin Buŋ kaak gudurre okintiti ɗo pisin̰ji.
Ki goy min awalle, ki goy diŋka ho ki asa goye. »

content: Gamin kuuk pooɗ siikimaw-ak, ŋu riyiyo ho ŋu oziliy Buŋ kaak goy ka seesji elgin iŋ elgina. Ŋu karmiyaaga ho ŋu deliiji barkine. Ho ay wiktin taat ŋu tees riye-aka,
aginay kuuk orok seer iŋ pooɗ-ak gay, dersiy ɗo uŋji ka waan kaak goy ka seesji. Ŋu abdiyaag ŋaar kaak goy elgin iŋ elgina. Kar ŋu ceepiig kadumuulinco ho ŋu leeyig ɗo uŋji ho ŋu ɗiy aman :

content.text: Kiŋ kat kilgiyig iŋ saawin ta meen̰jiŋ. »

footnotes.text: ‛irn̰a cuu ar dambay kuuk gasɗo badam’ : Iŋ kaaw ta Grek, ŋa irn̰e ka dambay kuuk ŋu koliy ‛jaspe’ ho ‛sarduwaan’.
‛irn̰a cuu balan̰ ar dambay kuuk samaan-aku’ : Iŋ kaaw ta Grek, ŋa irn̰e ka dambay kuuk ŋu koliy ‛emerood’.
